description: This file defines an interface for a grain that manages counters, including methods for adding, resetting, retrieving tentative and confirmed states, and confirming events.

classes.name: ICountersGrain
classes.description: An interface for a grain that maintains counters identified by string keys, supporting operations like add, reset, retrieve, and confirm.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Updates the counter for the specified key by the given amount, optionally waiting for confirmation.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets all counters to zero, optionally waiting for confirmation.

methods.name: GetTentativeCount
methods.description: Retrieves the tentative value of the counter for a specific key.

methods.name: GetTentativeState
methods.description: Retrieves the tentative values of all counters.

methods.name: GetConfirmedState
methods.description: Retrieves the confirmed values of all counters.
